The film highlights the tragedy of young girls being sold by needy parents to affluent Indians in the Gulf. It portrays the oppression by the rich and powerful on the downtrodden and the needy people. Sarju and Shabnam are in love, and wish to get married. However, Shabnam's dad has finalized her marriage with an elderly man, who is wealthy, and has shown an interest in Shabnam. Will Shabnam's love prove to be stronger than the power of money?
